title: Zesty Crispy Thai Chicken Skillet
description: A winey and crispy one-pot Thai dish featuring vanilla bean paste and flambe, made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and crispy, about 5-7 minutes
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Add the fish sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until the sauce is bubbly
Add the white wine to the skillet and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 2 minutes
Add the vanilla bean paste to the skillet and stir to combine
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce
Flambe the skillet by igniting the wine sauce with a match or lighter, then simmer for an additional 2 minutes
